acceptance_criteria: A failed or unparseable typing probe does not emit a synthetic typing-stop event or erase the last observed typing set.
The next successful unchanged observation after a failed probe emits no false typing-start event, while a successful empty observation retires prior typing state.
Repeated probe failures produce bounded episode-based diagnostics without logging one raw warning for every failed request.
A documented stale-entry policy transitions or retires typing state after a bounded unobserved interval, and removal of an instance retires its state immediately.
blast_radius: Realtime typing indicators and fleet diagnostics across all instances; false stop/start events confuse operators, while unbounded retained state and repeated warnings can hide the true probe episode.
evidence_summary: Merged PR #2423 fixed the central observation error on pinned main: failed and unparseable probes preserve the last observed typing set, valid empty observations retire it, and removed instances are retired; six focused #2137 tests encode those cases. The issue remains partial because the proxy still logs each failure individually and a perpetually present but unobserved instance can retain lastTyping without a time-bound stale-state transition. The fully paginated open-PR scan found no current owner or path overlap.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The remaining claims are falsified if pinned-main code already rate-bounds proxy warnings by failure episode and enforces an explicit elapsed-time stale policy for a present but continuously unobserved instance. Those mechanisms were not found. The decisive poller and proxy tests were not run in this write-free lane because they create temporary state or listeners; their pinned source and assertions were inspected, so runtime execution remains required before completion.
impact: The merged fix prevents false typing transitions, but prolonged outages can retain indefinitely stale typing state and flood diagnostics with repetitive proxy warnings.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2137 immediately before publication and reject the record if its updated timestamp, title, labels, or body hash changed.
Run the poller and proxy suites in an isolated mutable harness and add elapsed-time stale-state plus bounded-warning episode coverage before claiming the residual fixed.
Re-scan open pull requests immediately before assigning ownership; no open owner or touched-path overlap existed in the pinned 39-PR inventory.

partial_findings.summary: Merged PR #2423 preserves prior typing state on failed or unparseable observations and retires state on valid empty observations or fleet removal.
Proxy failures are still logged per request without an episode or rate bound.
A present instance that remains unobserved can carry its last typing set indefinitely because no elapsed-time stale policy exists.

pull_request_overlaps.title: fix(fleet): stop treating a failed typing probe as an empty typing set (#2137)

suggested_remediation: Retain the corrected observation semantics, add a monotonic last-observed timestamp and explicit stale transition for continuously failing instances, and coalesce proxy warnings into bounded failure episodes with recovery summaries.
title: Preserve typing state across failed instance probes
